svg.title: Defense-in-depth security, privacy and compliance layers / Defense-in-Depth Sicherheits-, Datenschutz- und Compliance-Schichten
svg.desc: Four security and legal pillars: 1. edge & transport security (Turnstile, CSP, Trusted Types, HSTS), 2. authentication & cryptography (WebAuthn passkeys, AES-256-GCM BYOK envelope encryption, SSRF guard), 3. EU law & data protection (GDPR Art. 15/17/20, EU AI Act Art. 50, TDDDG, DDG), 4. accessibility & supply chain (WCAG 2.2 AAA, OpenSSF Scorecard, CodeQL, osv-scanner). / Vier Sicherheits- und Rechts-Säulen: 1. Edge- & Transport-Sicherheit (Turnstile, CSP, Trusted Types, HSTS), 2. Authentifizierung & Kryptografie (WebAuthn Passkeys, AES-256-GCM BYOK Envelope Encryption, SSRF-Guard), 3. EU-Recht & Datenschutz (DSGVO Art. 15/17/20, EU AI Act Art. 50, TDDDG, DDG), 4. Barrierefreiheit & Supply-Chain (WCAG 2.2 AAA, OpenSSF Scorecard, CodeQL, osv-scanner).
